name: dsh-doctor
description: Read-only profile and token-meter inspectors for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --pretty false --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node src/*.ts tests/*.test.ts
scripts.bundle: tsdown src/index.ts --clean --dts --format esm --out-dir lib && node --input-type=module -e "import { rename } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rename('lib/index.mjs', 'lib/index.js'); await rename('lib/index.d.mts', 'lib/index.d.ts')"
